Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A generic institutional records office receives submitted forms, assigns each an intake reference, routes the form to the assigned examiner for verification, and stores the completed form, examiner sign-off, and related correspondence in a single case folder indexed by reference number and date.

2) What occurred: On a recorded date, the actor submitted a written request to a named inspector through a documented channel, attaching a proposed payment amount as a line item within the request; the inspector's acknowledgment of the request was never filed. On a subsequent date, the actor placed a payment of a stated amount to a named account, and the payment reference field on the inspection file remained unverified. On a later date, the actor produced a revised inspection report bearing a new pass status; the original inspector's signature block on that report was never verified. On the same date, the actor submitted the revised report to the records office, and the cross-check against the original file's serial number remained unperformed. On a further date, the actor requested and obtained a copy of the case folder, and the access log entry for that retrieval was never reconciled. On the final recorded date, the actor transmitted the payment receipt through the same channel, and the receipt's matching field against the inspection file remained unverified.

3) Materials/access observed: A written request document with a proposed payment line; a payment receipt tied to a named account; a revised inspection report with an altered status field; a copy of the original inspection report; a case folder index entry; and a channel transmission log entry.

4) Indicators & artifacts: A payment line item appearing in a non-financial correspondence document; a status field change without a corresponding examiner signature verification; a file serial number mismatch between the original and revised reports; an access log entry lacking a reconciling reviewer sign-off; and a receipt whose reference field does not match any field in the case folder.
